title: Undo the last commit
concept: git reset --soft HEAD~1 keeps your changes

story.speaker: Ada
story.text: You committed too early! Let's undo the commit but keep the file changes.

hints: You want to undo the last commit but keep your files.
`git reset --soft HEAD~1` removes the commit but keeps changes staged.
Answer the question about soft reset.

questions.explanation: Soft reset removes the commit but leaves the files in the staging area.

recap: git reset --soft HEAD~1 undoes the last commit but keeps your edits safe.
